questions.q: What is the positive solution to the quadratic equation $3x^2 - 10x - 8 = 0$?
questions.answer: Factor by grouping: $(3x + 2)(x - 4) = 0$. The roots are $x = -\frac{2}{3}$ and $x = 4$. The positive solution is $4$.

questions.q: If $x^2 - 6x + k = 0$ has two equal real roots, what is the value of $k$?
questions.answer: Equal real roots require discriminant $D = b^2 - 4ac = 0$: $(-6)^2 - 4(1)(k) = 0 \Rightarrow 36 - 4k = 0 \Rightarrow k = 9$.

questions.q: What is the sum of the solutions of the quadratic equation $2x^2 + 8x - 15 = 0$?
questions.answer: By Vieta's formula, sum of roots is $-\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{8}{2} = -4$.

questions.q: What is the minimum value of the quadratic function $f(x) = 2x^2 - 12x + 23$?
The parabola $y = -(x - 4)^2 + 16$ models the flight path of a projectile. What is the maximum height achieved?
questions.answer: In vertex form $y = a(x - h)^2 + k$, since $a = -1 < 0$, the maximum occurs at vertex $(4, 16)$, giving maximum height $16$.

questions.q: What is the axis of symmetry of the parabola $y = x^2 + 8x - 5$?
What is the remainder when $P(x) = x^3 - 4x^2 + 5x - 7$ is divided by $(x - 2)$?
If $(x - 3)$ is a factor of $x^3 - 2x^2 - kx + 12$, what is the value of $k$?
Which of the following polynomials has roots at $x = -1, x = 2,$ and $x = 3$?
What are all real roots of the polynomial equation $x^4 - 5x^2 + 4 = 0$?
questions.answer: Factor as quadratic in $x^2$: $(x^2 - 1)(x^2 - 4) = 0 \Rightarrow x^2 = 1 \Rightarrow x = \pm 1$, and $x^2 = 4 \Rightarrow x = \pm 2$.

questions.q: What is the product of the roots of the cubic equation $2x^3 - 6x^2 + 4x - 10 = 0$?
questions.answer: By Vieta's formulas, product of roots of $ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d = 0$ is $-\frac{d}{a} = -\frac{-10}{2} = 5$.

questions.q: How many times does the graph of $f(x) = (x - 1)^2 (x + 3)$ cross the $x$-axis?
questions.answer: Root $x = 1$ has even multiplicity $2$ (tangent/bounces without crossing). Root $x = -3$ has odd multiplicity $1$ (crosses). Thus it crosses the $x$-axis exactly $1$ time.
